method: Condensed OpenAI capability headings (docs/openai-audit/openai_capability_areas.md) grouped into major features; Allternit equivalents established by read-only code exploration with file:line evidence. Very similar headings are grouped per task instructions.

findings.openai_feature: Responses API (create, input items, streaming events)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Replies runtime (POST /v1/replies, SSE run events) + OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions gateway
findings.notes: Stateful reply/run model with SSE exists, but no full Responses API surface (input items CRUD, encrypted reasoning items, hosted tool outputs). Gateway translates OpenAI chat-completions shape onto the internal Gizzi bus.

findings.allternit_equivalent: OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway /v1/chat/completions with SSE streaming and usage chunks
findings.notes: Full middleware chain (key auth -> rate limit -> DLP -> budget) in front of proxy handler.

findings.allternit_equivalent: None
findings.notes: No legacy /v1/completions endpoint; low value since OpenAI itself deprecates it.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Zod/JSON-schema tool registry + permission-gated tool-call loop in gizzi-code runtime; gateway validates OpenAI tool shapes
findings.notes: Gateway validates tools for shape but does not forward them to the agent bus (translate.rs:108-109); execution lives in the agent runtime. Only 'function' tool type accepted at the gateway.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Internal generateObject/streamObject with zod schemas; gateway response_format field shape-validated only
findings.notes: No enforcement of schema-constrained decoding at the served API layer; no public structured-output endpoint.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Cached-token accounting in usage pipeline
findings.notes: cached_tokens/cache_write_tokens recorded per request, but no cache-control feature exposed to callers.

findings.allternit_equivalent: None served; embeddings consumed from Ollama/local sidecars
findings.notes: No /v1/embeddings route. Semantic search degrades to keyword fallback when no embedding service is configured.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Provider-proxied generation route + agent image-generation mode (bonsai-local/openai/stability)
findings.notes: Thin proxy to third-party providers via runtime credentials; no self-hosted image model serving.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Computer-use vision grounding loop; gateway degrades image parts to text placeholders
findings.notes: Real multimodal use exists in the computer-use pipeline, but the served chat API substitutes '[image_url]' placeholders instead of forwarding images.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Voice service TTS (Chatterbox/XTTS/Piper backends) POST /v1/voice/tts
findings.notes: Python FastAPI service is the real implementation; the Rust mirror is self-described as simulated.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Whisper-backed STT POST /v1/stt/transcribe
findings.notes: No separate translation endpoint.

findings.openai_feature: Audio Voices / Voice Consents (voice cloning admin)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Voice cloning endpoint + agent voice presets
findings.notes: Clone endpoint exists; no consent-management resource model.

findings.openai_feature: Realtime API (WebRTC/WebSocket speech-to-speech, Realtime Calls, Client Secrets)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Streaming TTS/STT endpoint stubs; WebRTC used only for browser screen streaming
findings.notes: No bidirectional realtime audio session layer, no ephemeral client secrets; Rust streaming routes are stubs ('return the same as non-streaming').

findings.allternit_equivalent: General async job/task infrastructure (create/start/complete/cancel, queue claiming)
findings.notes: Job infra exists for agent runs, but no OpenAI-style 24h discounted LLM batch endpoint.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Upload routes (base64, 20MB cap) + workspace file CRUD
findings.notes: No purpose/expiration semantics; files are workspace artifacts, not LLM-context resources.

findings.allternit_equivalent: None
findings.notes: Only base64-JSON envelope uploads exist; no multipart/resumable upload protocol.

findings.openai_feature: Vector Stores (+ file batches, file search tool)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Memory fabric with vector search (Ollama embeddings; Qdrant enum) + /memory/query API
findings.notes: Semantic recall exists but no vector-store CRUD resources and no file-search tool over managed stores; vector index is in-memory with comments pointing at Qdrant/pgvector for production.

findings.allternit_equivalent: None (DLP middleware covers secrets/injection, not content moderation)
findings.notes: No content-classifier endpoint or moderation model integration served; only outbound connector calls to OpenAI moderations.

findings.allternit_equivalent: None
findings.notes: Fine-tuning appears only in outbound third-party connectors (e.g. services/open-connector Mistral executors).

findings.allternit_equivalent: Benchmark-weighted model router with seeded scores; self-improve eval boundary (scaffold)
findings.notes: Benchmark scores influence routing but there is no user-defined eval/grader CRUD; self-improve module explicitly states no real evaluator lives there.

findings.allternit_equivalent: OpenAI-shaped GET /v1/models plus flattened catalog merging static specs and live local models
findings.notes: Catalog merges Ollama/HF GGUF live models; models.dev snapshot drives the provider catalog in gizzi-code.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Policy-based cross-provider routing with fallback chains, cost/benchmark weights, routing-decision audit
findings.notes: Beyond OpenAI: cost-aware routing with persisted decisions linked to usage rows; server-side cost recompute from models.dev pricing cache.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Sandbox execute API + VM session API (Firecracker/Apple VF)
findings.notes: Functionally a code-execution-container API, but not bound to LLM responses as a hosted tool the way OpenAI containers are.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Conversations CRUD with replies and fork
findings.notes: Includes /conversations/:id/fork which OpenAI conversations lack.

findings.openai_feature: Assistants API (assistants, threads, runs, run steps)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Agent CRUD with system prompts/tools + runs router in replies-runtime
findings.notes: Assistants-like agent objects exist; no thread run-steps inspection API. OpenAI itself is deprecating Assistants in favor of Responses.

findings.allternit_equivalent: WebSearchTool/WebFetchTool builtins + search connectors (Brave, Tavily, Exa, Perplexity, SerpApi)
findings.notes: Agent-side tools, not a hosted Responses-API tool type.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Agent-side shell execution (BashTool) + executor backends with microVM sandboxing
findings.notes: More powerful (full shell/VM) but self-managed; no managed notebook-style interpreter tool with file attachments.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Full computer-use domain: plan-act-observe-reflect loop, pointer/keyboard protocol, multi-provider vision grounding
findings.notes: One of Allternit's strongest areas; includes GIF session recording and persistent observation store.

findings.openai_feature: Built-in tools: MCP tool / remote MCP servers
findings.allternit_equivalent: Full MCP client (stdio/SSE/streamable HTTP/WS, OAuth 2.1+PKCE, elicitation) + MCP server hosting
findings.notes: TS client is full-featured; Rust mcp/core client lags (stdio+SSE only, mcp/core/src/transport/mod.rs:17-22).

findings.allternit_equivalent: Inbound webhook receivers (Clerk/Svix, Stripe, Slack); outbound delivery stub only
findings.notes: No user-configurable outbound webhook subscriptions; webhook_secret field is a None stub. Events otherwise surface via SSE.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Usage summary, gateway usage/logs/budgets, per-key sliding-window rate limiting, cloud cost APIs
findings.notes: Cost recompute server-side from pricing cache; budgets enforced in the gateway middleware chain.

findings.openai_feature: Organization admin (projects, users, groups, roles, invites, service accounts, admin API keys, audit logs)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Clerk JWT auth + RBAC helpers, virtual gateway keys, audit log routes, governance identities/orgs/roles/groups
findings.notes: Strong identity/RBAC core, but no first-class projects/service-accounts/invites resource hierarchy mirroring OpenAI's org admin API.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Provider-proxied video generation route + agent video mode (MiniMax, Runway, Pika, SVD)
findings.notes: All third-party integrations; no self-hosted video model.

findings.allternit_equivalent: SSE chat streaming endpoints for Allternit's own surfaces
findings.notes: No white-label embeddable chat component/server with a public embed API.

findings.openai_feature: Agents SDK (Python/TS agent framework, tracing, guardrails)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Orchestrator + cowork-engine + skills + OTel telemetry in agent runtime
findings.notes: Agent-building capability exists but is not packaged as a standalone public SDK with a tracing UI.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Hand-registered Axum routes; OpenAPI only for sub-services
findings.notes: No spec-driven public API documentation for the main control plane.

findings.allternit_equivalent: gizzi-code ink TUI + allternit-mux PTY multiplexer
findings.notes: Heavily Claude-Code-derived with Allternit additions (cowork, swarm, vault, runtimes). The commander-based cmd/cli is mostly stubs.

findings.allternit_equivalent: IDE detection + ACP protocol client; vscode:// deep links from platform
findings.notes: No first-party VS Code/JetBrains extension found; integration is protocol-level (ACP) plus deep links.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Electron desktop surface + Next.js web chat

findings.openai_feature: Codex cloud (delegate tasks to cloud sandboxes)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Paired-runtime daemon with WSS relay, hosted runtime on Fly, orchestrator 'cloud' backend
Orchestrator spawn/watch/kill contract, coordinator mode, parallel-run multi-model variants, swarm commands
SKILL.md skill system with runtime activation tool, bundled skills, cross-CLI skill sync engine
findings.notes: Skill portability engine syncs skills across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Kimi.

findings.allternit_equivalent: GIZZI.md canonical + AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/CONTEXT.md compat reading; policy-bundle hashing of AGENTS.md
POLICY.md workspace files + approval auto-rules with risk tiers
memdir subsystem + scoped memory service (userId/projectId/sessionId) with optional semantic search
Cron CLI + TaskScheduler daemon + server-side scheduler service with misfire policy
findings.notes: Natural-language schedules supported; heartbeat executor on the platform side.

findings.allternit_equivalent: /review, /ultrareview, /autofix-pr, /pr commands + orchestrator review verdicts + reviewer agent template

findings.openai_feature: Codex Security (scanning, threat modeling, bulk repo scans)
findings.allternit_equivalent: /security-review, /bughunter, security-compliance plugin skill (LLM-driven)
findings.notes: LLM-driven review only; no deterministic SAST engine, no threat-model artifact workflow, no bulk scan management.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Safety tiers T0-T4 + PolicySpec permissive/restrictive profiles + WASM deny-by-default capabilities + microVM isolation
findings.notes: Arguably deeper than Codex: capability-granted WASM sandbox plus Firecracker jailing; profile granularity differs from Codex's named three modes.

findings.allternit_equivalent: allow/deny/ask policy decisions, two-man rule for destructive tiers, approval request lifecycle, cloud approvals API

findings.openai_feature: Filesystem sandbox policy (writable roots, deny-read globs)
findings.allternit_equivalent: FilePolicy read/write paths + deny_dot_files + WASM path-scoped capability grants
findings.notes: No glob-based deny-read rules beyond dotfiles.

findings.openai_feature: Network access policy (domain allowlists, method scoping, proxy)
findings.allternit_equivalent: NetworkPolicy (egress, allowed hosts/ports, DNS) enforced via tc + iptables on microVM TAP devices; capsule allowlists
findings.notes: Enforced at OS level (stronger than Codex's process proxy), but no HTTP-method scoping.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Policy bundles hashed into ledger (AGENTS.md + .allternit dirs); no managed-config distribution
findings.notes: Policy-as-code with hash-locked injection exists; no admin-pushed user-unoverridable settings channel like requirements.toml.

findings.openai_feature: MCP servers in the agent (config, OAuth, elicitation)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Full MCP client config with all transports + OAuth 2.1/PKCE + elicitation hooks + policy-tier approval on tool calls

findings.openai_feature: Plugins for Codex/ChatGPT (install, curated lists, marketplaces)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Plugin SDK (allternit-plugin-v1 manifests) + marketplace with curated manifests, submission/review flow, installer

findings.openai_feature: Git worktree management for concurrent agent sessions
findings.allternit_equivalent: worktree-manager Rust crate (.allternit/worktrees) + orchestrator worktree isolation + TUI worktree utils

findings.openai_feature: Session management (fork, compact, resume, archive, rewind)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Compaction, resume, fork, checkpoint/rewind, teleport cross-host handoff
findings.notes: Thread archiving not found; everything else present including cross-host handoff.

findings.openai_feature: Slash commands / custom prompts / prompt library
findings.allternit_equivalent: ~100 CLI commands + composer slash API + markdown command files + template gallery

findings.openai_feature: Model selection / reasoning effort / alternative model providers
findings.allternit_equivalent: Multi-provider catalog (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Kimi, Qwen, GLM, Ollama via openai-compatible), /models and /provider commands, reasoning effort, complexity-tier request scorer
findings.notes: Provider breadth exceeds Codex (which is OpenAI-first); models.dev-driven dynamic catalog.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Desktop/TUI notifier (osascript) + browser Notification API
findings.notes: No Web Push / pushManager infrastructure found.

findings.openai_feature: Voice in the agent (voice mode, dictation)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Voice service (STT/TTS) + TUI voice mode + /voice command + agent voice presets
findings.notes: No realtime speech-to-speech conversation loop.

findings.allternit_equivalent: browser-tools (Playwright sessions, quarantine) + WebRTC Chrome streaming + browser capsule + /chrome command
findings.notes: WebRTC-embedded real Chrome is beyond ChatGPT's browser feature.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Computer-use domain with plan-act-observe-reflect loop and multi-provider vision grounding
findings.notes: Providers: local-playwright, extension-tab, browser-use, stagehand.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Screenshot/GIF recording pipeline + accessibility inspector + persistent observation store
findings.notes: Capture infrastructure exists for agent observation, but no user-facing 'recent screen context' product feature like Chronicle.

findings.openai_feature: Mobile companion (iOS app, continue tasks from phone)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Native iOS app + phone-claim handoff + remote session manager + mesh tsnet iOS spike
findings.notes: iOS app exists; tsnet mesh node is a feasibility spike; /mobile and /teleport CLI entry files are 0-byte stubs.

findings.openai_feature: Telemetry / OTel / analytics on agent usage
findings.allternit_equivalent: OpenTelemetry in TUI + cost tracker + platform telemetry service + usage routes
findings.notes: No productized analytics dashboard API like ChatGPT Work's Analytics API.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Governance domain: orgs/roles/groups/scoped tokens/mTLS, retention limits via purpose-binding, identity revocation, kill switch
findings.notes: No data-residency region pinning or zero-data-retention mode found.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Append-only HistoryLedger + audit events with trace ids + standalone audit HTTP service + rails receipts
findings.notes: Standalone audit service is in-memory (10k cap); rails ledger is the durable trail. Receipts are hash-verified but not cryptographically signed.

findings.openai_feature: Codex App Server / remote Code Mode hosts
findings.allternit_equivalent: Agent-daemon pairing (ed25519 identity, token rotation) + runtime relay + remote session WebSocket
config/allternit.json + gizzi-code runtime config + brain-presets for external agent CLIs

findings.openai_feature: Sites (build and deploy websites from chat)
findings.allternit_equivalent: None found
findings.notes: No managed site-deploy product surface identified in the audited slices.

findings.openai_feature: Import from other agents (Claude Code /import, config detection)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Brain presets for external CLIs (claude-code, aider, goose) + skill portability engine + vendor launch matrix
findings.notes: Allternit orchestrates competing CLIs rather than importing from them; functionally a superset.

findings.openai_feature: Build an MCP server (Apps SDK fundamentals)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Plugin SDK MCP adapter (stdio/http/websocket) + open-connector McpServer exposing ~800 providers

findings.openai_feature: Add UI to your MCP server (widgets/web components in chat)
findings.allternit_equivalent: MCP Apps app-bridge rendering (sandboxed iframe) + capsule HTML surfaces with declared permissions + signed mini-app system
findings.notes: Two parallel systems: MCP Apps protocol widgets and Allternit's own Ed25519-signed mini-apps.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Capsule NetworkPolicy/SecretsPolicy + mini-app permission explainers + CSP carried in mcp_app events
OAuth 2.1 + PKCE for MCP + per-mini-app OAuth connections and per-user secrets panels
findings.notes: OAuth vault stores tokens as plaintext JSON files (rails/src/vault/oauth.rs:18-34) — no KMS/encryption at rest.

findings.openai_feature: Plugin marketplace / directory / curated lists / discovery
findings.allternit_equivalent: Marketplace API with curated manifests + GitHub fallback, installer, CLI marketplace command, iOS marketplace client
Submission endpoint with pending status + review console with manifest diffs and kill switches
findings.notes: Appeals flow not found.

findings.allternit_equivalent: None
findings.notes: No price/purchase/checkout flow in marketplace, plugin SDK, or mini-app manifests; Stripe exists only as a connector plugins can call.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Plugin SDK manifest + host contract + multi-transport adapters; local testing implied by SDK structure
findings.notes: No dedicated scaffolding CLI like @plugin-creator found; platform/plugins is a second, thinner runtime that does not share SDK types.

findings.openai_feature: Build skills / connect skills to MCP tools / distribute skills with plugins
findings.allternit_equivalent: Skill activation tool + skill-import/skill-growth + bundled plugin skills

findings.openai_feature: Plugin guidelines (design system, accessibility, fair play)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Review console + permission explainers; no published guideline docs for third-party developers
findings.notes: Enforcement machinery exists; developer-facing guideline documentation does not.

findings.openai_feature: Workspace Agent access tokens (provision, scoped access)
findings.allternit_equivalent: ScopedToken with scopes/expiry/revocation + virtual gateway API keys + git-scoped brain tokens
POST /api/v1/runs with start/pause/resume/cancel + gateway agent-runs route
findings.notes: Gateway-mirrored variant (services/gateway) is a stub that returns pending and never executes; the cloud-api route is the real one.

findings.allternit_equivalent: GET /runs/:id + SSE run events + checkpoints API
findings.notes: SSE event stream and checkpoint inspection exceed the workspace-agents poll model.

findings.openai_feature: Cookbook code examples and patterns (grouped: 2581 headings of recipes)
findings.allternit_equivalent: docs/ architecture + guides + A://Labs generated courses
findings.notes: Cookbook is OpenAI's example corpus, not a product capability; Allternit has internal docs and a course pipeline but no public developer-recipe corpus.

findings.allternit_equivalent: Ollama live-model integration + HF GGUF catalog + local brain routes
findings.notes: Local-model operation is a first-class platform feature, stronger than a cookbook recipe.

findings.openai_feature: Multi-hour problem solving with PLANS.md / ExecPlans
findings.allternit_equivalent: Workspace .md layer spec (SOUL/IDENTITY/MEMORY/POLICY/BRAIN) + checkpoint/resume + plan-approve execution

findings.openai_feature: Codex CLI customization (themes, syntax highlighting, shell completions, prompt editor)
findings.allternit_equivalent: Ink TUI with screens/components and extensive command set
findings.notes: TUI is rich but explicit theme/shell-completion/prompt-editor docs equivalents were not identified.

findings.allternit_equivalent: config/allternit.json + policy bundles + brain presets
findings.notes: No single consolidated config-reference document found; config is spread across system config, presets, and policy bundles.

findings.openai_feature: OpenAI Ads API (campaigns, ad groups, creatives, conversions, insights)
findings.allternit_equivalent: None
findings.notes: OpenAI's advertising business; not a platform capability Allternit would replicate. Grouped: all 152 unique headings.

findings.openai_feature: Agentic commerce (product feeds, checkout spec, promotions)
findings.allternit_equivalent: None
findings.notes: Merchant-feed/checkout protocol for ChatGPT shopping. If agentic payments ever matter, this is a gap; today it is out of scope. Grouped: all 131 unique headings.

findings.allternit_equivalent: None
findings.notes: Editorial content, not a capability. Grouped: all 290 unique headings.

findings.openai_feature: OpenAI Learn (docs MCP, developer plugin, guides)
findings.allternit_equivalent: A://Labs curriculum-as-code pipeline (10 courses, 65 modules, Canvas LMS sync)
findings.notes: Allternit has a real learning platform for its own codebase; no public docs-MCP server for external developers.

findings.openai_feature: Learning tracks (AI app development, building agents, model optimization)
findings.allternit_equivalent: A://Labs course catalog (CORE/OPS/AGENTS/ADV tiers)
findings.notes: Educational tracks exist for the Allternit platform itself. Grouped: all 59 unique headings.
